units: m, rad, kg, s; explicitly suffixed fields use deg or mm

table.note: Radius and spacing adopted from the existing viewer, per user instruction. No threads.

robot.note: Base height and reference sample match tactile pick_runtime.py. Spacer radius is a visual approximation. URDF kinematics are nominal, not factory calibrated.

flange_adapter.note: Cylinder dimensions match the tactile preview; density is an aluminum assumption. Bolt holes/CAD are not supplied. Attached to UR tool0, not the differently oriented ROS flange frame.

gripper.note: WSG 050-110 body mesh; symmetric box fingers match preview dimensions. Actual asymmetric tactile fingers/GelSight geometry and contact properties are not identified. Joint coordinates are half the inner jaw gap.

simulation.note: Position servos, damping and friction are simulation defaults, not identified hardware parameters.
